plus.light: You hold on to a few traditions that mean something to you.
plus.clear: Rituals matter to you. You keep birthdays and holidays feeling special.
plus.strong: You keep the traditions alive. Without you, some would quietly fade.

minus.light: You follow the usual way until it stops fitting, then you make it your own.
minus.clear: You'd rather shape love, home and holidays yourself than inherit a script.
minus.strong: Your life is built your way. The usual script has very little pull on you.

sheet.both: You keep the traditions that still mean something and let the rest go.

stats.plusKnow: Your rituals tell people they belong. The same song at birthdays, the same seat at dinner.
stats.minusKnow: You shape life your own way. The usual script stays only when it fits.
stats.flexKnow: You keep the traditions that matter and gently let the rest go.

plus.light: You enjoy something new, as long as there's solid ground to return to.
plus.clear: You'd rather return to a place you love than take a chance on a new one.
plus.strong: You know what works for you and you keep it close. Familiar feels like home.

minus.light: Given a free weekend, you'll usually try at least one new thing.
minus.clear: You'd rather discover a new place than return to your favorite.
minus.strong: The unknown pulls at you. You'd rather find out than know in advance.

sheet.both: Some seasons call you home, some call you out. You feel which is which.

stats.plusKnow: Your big steps rest on quiet preparation. People rarely see it, so they call it luck.
stats.minusKnow: A fully mapped plan leaves you restless. You'd rather find out as you go.
stats.flexKnow: You can feel which season you're in. Some call for certainty, some for the unknown.

plus.light: You like having a goal, and you keep it in proportion.
plus.clear: You want to see progress, and you keep going until you do.
plus.strong: Once you see a goal, you give it everything. Standing still is hard for you.

minus.light: You put in effort where it counts and let the rest be.
minus.clear: You move at your own pace, and other people's timelines don't rush you.
minus.strong: You've let go of the race entirely, and your calm is something people envy.

sheet.both: You know when to push and when to rest, and you trust that sense.

stats.plusKnow: You like to see that you're getting somewhere. A finished list, a goal reached.
stats.minusKnow: Your timeline is your own. You left a race you never chose, and it shows in your calm.
stats.flexKnow: You know when to push and when to rest, and you trust yourself on both.

plus.light: You value a fair system, and you'll make room for a good reason.
plus.clear: To you, fairness means the same rules for everyone.
plus.strong: You hold to what's fair when it's hard, because it protects everyone.

minus.light: A rule is a good starting point, and you check how it lands on people.
minus.clear: You look at the person before the policy, and you bend when it's kind.
minus.strong: When a rule hurts someone, you're already looking for another way through.

sheet.both: You follow the rules until someone needs more. Then you choose the person.

stats.plusKnow: Fairness matters to you in the details. You'll hold a line because it protects everyone.
stats.minusKnow: You look at the situation before the rulebook. When a rule hurts someone, you look for another way.
stats.flexKnow: You follow the rules until someone matters more. Then you choose the person, at peace.

tags.name: Makes my own traditions
tags.line: You'd rather create your own way of running a home than follow a script.
tags.heart: Building my own way of doing things is a gift I gave myself.
tags.sting: Without a script, every choice at home is yours, and sometimes yours to explain.
calls: Your future home will have at least one tradition you invented.
You'd cook every night if it meant never vacuuming again.
You've made up a holiday that only your friends celebrate.

tags.name: Says it with actions
tags.line: You rarely say how much you care. You show it by turning up and doing the thing.
tags.heart: What I do for people says what I sometimes can't put into words.
tags.sting: You always show up. Saying the tender part aloud is harder, and people would treasure it.
calls: You've fixed a friend's problem and changed the subject before they could say thanks.
Your version of comfort sounds like 'get in the car'.
You remember a friend's big day and act like it's no big deal.

tags.name: In it to win
tags.line: You want to build something that people can see and recognize.
tags.heart: Wanting something big for my life is allowed.
tags.sting: You remember every win, and one overlooked one stays with you longest.
calls: You have a folder of wins: kind emails, certificates, one legendary grade.
You've taken the hardest part of a project so your name would be on it.
You check the leaderboard even in games you 'play casually'.

tags.name: Family's first call
tags.line: When your family needs something, you want to be the one who helps.
tags.heart: When my family needs someone, I'm glad it's me.
tags.sting: You step in for your family every time, and your own plans wait.
calls: You're the one the family calls when the wifi breaks.
You've answered a family call during a date, a class or a movie.
In your family, 'can someone...' means you.

tags.name: Asks the AI first
tags.line: When you need to sort out a feeling, you often talk it through with an AI first.
tags.heart: Being understood matters to me, wherever it happens.
tags.sting: You may have told an AI more of your feelings than your friends. They'd want to hear it.
calls: You've asked an AI who was right in an argument.
You've said 'thank you' to an AI and meant it.
You've asked an AI what a text someone sent you really meant.

lines.line: You want your lives woven together: shared plans, shared routines, shared days.
When things feel uncertain at work, people look to you to hold steady.
You want progress people can see and a clear next step.
You love your family and make your own choices, and you hold both without apology.
You enjoy bending a game to fit the people playing it.
You're drawn to the new place, the new game, the new route home.

library.flex: You move between both sides of this, depending on the moment and the people.
